'''Shadowstrike''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell it was capable of being wielded by the [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell was allowed the caster to land blows on a target individual without physically touching them. Unless the target was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the individual could not dodge the blows.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[psychokinesis]] and [[sense life]] spells.
